Shwetanshu helps startups, businesses, and remote teams design, build, improve, and maintain dependable digital products. His strongest work connects product thinking with backend engineering, data models, APIs, job orchestration, AI integrations, and production delivery.

## Services

- Websites and custom web applications
- Full-stack development with React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, and Python
- Backend and REST API engineering
- PostgreSQL and SQL database design, migrations, and performance work
- AI integration, retrieval, structured outputs, and business automation
- Docker, Linux, deployment, technical SEO, performance, accessibility, and launch support

## Best fit

Work is a good fit for an MVP that needs one accountable technical owner, a business replacing manual workflows, a product outgrowing a fragile backend, or a team adding practical AI to existing software.
